name: Measure an object
description: Look at an object and report its current axis-aligned size.

size_m.description: World-frame size [dx, dy, dz] in metres.

verifier.name: measured
verifier.meaning: The robot recorded the object's size from a view with the object in the head camera.
verifier.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

verifier.name: in_view
verifier.meaning: Target point inside the head camera frustum, within 5 m, line of sight not blocked by furniture boxes.
verifier.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

policy_plan.selection: first path whose noun conditions all hold, decided before any motion
policy_plan.on_no_match: NO_PATH: the Contract refuses without moving

failure.automatic_fallback: nested calls only: a failed precondition with a matching repair fallback runs the repair once and retries; top-level calls stop
